XV De Tolerantia mutua, Hexades Annotationum Prooemium H.I–§.III, and Annotatio I De Augustana Confessione §.I–§.VII (Augsburg Confession definition through edition wars, Variata, and Dorsche subsumption) from Ingenua in Controversias Evangelicorum (Frankfurt an der Oder, 1708).
